		custom_effect_tooltip = {
			localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt
			MODIFIER = COLDWAR_SWE_national_economy_modifier
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_national_economy_offices_productivity = 0.06
			tooltip = offices_productivity_tt
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_national_economy_corporate_tax_income_multiplier_modifier = -0.03
			tooltip = corporate_tax_income_multiplier_modifier_tt
		}
	}
	effect_tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				hidden_trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_delivered_private_capital
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = {
				temp_opinion = 8
			}
			change_small_medium_business_owners_opinion = yes
			set_temp_variable = {
				temp_opinion = -5
			}
			change_labour_unions_opinion = yes
		}
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_national_can_fund_private_capital = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_SWE_national_deliver_private_capital = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_funding_pending_private_capital
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = {
					COLDWAR_SWE_national_can_fund_private_capital = yes
				}
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SWE_national_funding_later
	}
}

			}

			33 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = {
					type = industrial_complex
					level = 1
					instant_build = yes
				}
			}
			34 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
				add_building_construction = {
					type = arms_factory
					level = 1
					instant_build = yes
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = {
			temp_opinion = -5
		}
		change_industrial_conglomerates_opinion = yes
	}
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_funding_pending_state_industry
	COLDWAR_SWE_national_rebuild_modifiers_effect = yes
}

		}
	}

}

COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_referendum_start_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = SWE
			original_tag = SWE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_national_initialised
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_delivered_referendum
			has_elections = yes
			AND = {
				set_temp_variable = {
					COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget = {
						value = gdp_total
						multiply = 0.003
					}
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = treasury
					value = COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_nuclear_ballot_working
			}
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_referendum_started
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = {
			treasury_change = {
				value = gdp_total
				multiply = -0.003
			}
		}
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_referendum_started
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_nuclear_ballot_working
	}
}
COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_referendum_count_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = SWE
			original_tag = SWE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_national_initialised
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_delivered_referendum
			has_elections = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_referendum_started
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_referendum_ready
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_referendum_counted
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line1 = party_pop_array^1
		}
		set_temp_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line2 = {
				value = party_pop_array^3
				add = party_pop_array^2
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line3 = {
				value = party_pop_array^15
				add = party_pop_array^5
				add = party_pop_array^14
				add = party_pop_array^17
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line1
					value = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line2
					compare = greater_than
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line1
					value = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line3
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_nuclear_mandate = 1
			}
			COLDWAR_SWE_national_deliver_cw_nuclear_ballot_line_1 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line2
					value = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line3
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_nuclear_mandate = 2
			}
			COLDWAR_SWE_national_deliver_cw_nuclear_ballot_line_2 = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = {
				COLDWAR_SWE_nuclear_mandate = 3
			}
			COLDWAR_SWE_national_deliver_cw_nuclear_ballot_line_3 = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_referendum_counted
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_referendum_ready
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_nuclear_ballot_working
	}
}

			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_referendum_counted
			NOT = {

			}
		}

COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_mandate_revision_count_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = SWE
			original_tag = SWE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_national_initialised
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_delivered_mandate_revision
			has_elections = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_mandate_revision_started
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_mandate_revision_ready
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_mandate_revision_counted
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_referendum_counted
		}
		set_temp_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line1 = party_pop_array^1
		}
		set_temp_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line2 = {
				value = party_pop_array^3
				add = party_pop_array^2
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line3 = {
				value = party_pop_array^15
				add = party_pop_array^5
				add = party_pop_array^14
				add = party_pop_array^17
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = {
			COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_revision_score = {
				value = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line1
				add = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_line2
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					COLDWAR_SWE_parliament_support > 0.50
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_revision_score
					value = 0.60
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_nuclear_mandate_revised
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_mandate_revision_accepted
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_mandate_revision_rejected
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_mandate_revision_counted
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_ballot_mandate_revision_ready
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_nuclear_ballot_working
	}
}
